program.name: 30/30 Intervals
program.subject: HIIT
program.blurb: Thirty seconds flat out, thirty seconds easy, every minute on the minute.
program.about: Thirty seconds flat out, then thirty seconds easy, every minute on the minute. The work is sprints in place, fast feet and shuffles, alternating with jump and bodyweight minutes. A short circuit follows on one of the days, and abs close each session. Levels II and III add reps. Simple to follow: the timer tells you when to go.
